message: COPY POSREC (line 44) and COPY TRNREC (line 45) appear directly under FILE SECTION (line 43), before any FD entry. Their records POSITION-RECORD and TRANSACTION-RECORD are linked by EXPANDS_COPY from the FILE section (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0079-SEC-0003) with no fd_name and are not registered as program FILE records.
SELECT POSITION-MASTER (line 26) and SELECT TRANSACTION-HISTORY (line 32) have no FD entry in the FILE SECTION; only VALIDATION-CONTROL (FD line 47) and ERROR-REPORT (FD line 54) have FDs.
RECORD KEY POS-KEY of SELECT POSITION-MASTER (line 29) is declared in copybook POSREC (line 7).
RECORD KEY TRAN-KEY of SELECT TRANSACTION-HISTORY (line 32) is not declared in UTLVAL00 nor in copybook TRNREC; no data item named TRAN-KEY was found in any copybook of the inventory.
